entities.name: Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge
entities.description: A vampire of Innistrad who steals the minds of archmages and hunters from her mansion in Nephalia.

entities.name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
entities.description: A former king who became a lich lord after being killed in his own throne room and now monitors the court through informants.

entities.name: Oloro, Ageless Ascetic
entities.description: A manipulator of life and death who guards the secret of eternal life on a mist-shrouded island.

entities.name: Sydri, Galvanic Genius
entities.description: A young master of metalwork and mystical animation who sells her devices to anyone who pays.

entities.name: Marath, Will of the Wild
entities.description: An elusive beast of a shaman-ruled world, believed by elves to be the source of growth and natural justice.

entities.name: Gahiji, Honored One
entities.description: A beast revered as a god by the Rahode tribe, who saved them at the Battle of Flat Sky.

entities.name: Prossh, Skyraider of Kher
entities.description: A dragon who dominates the Kher region of Dominaria and is worshipped by kobolds.

entities.name: Shattergang Brothers
entities.description: A goblin family of demolition-for-hire in Ravnica sought by thieves and priests.

entities.name: Derevi, Empyrial Tactician
entities.description: A flying commander called the greatest the Shards have seen, who routed the Grixis hordes at the Battle of Split Peak.

entities.name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
entities.description: A rhox deserter of the Herald's Army who became a prophet and guardian of the gate of the Hidden Realm.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Powerful church of Innistrad that has put a price on Jeleva's head.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A dark province of Innistrad.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane terrorized by Jeleva.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the Shattergang Brothers work.

entities.name: Kher
entities.description: A region of Dominaria ruled by Prossh.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane containing the Kher region.

entities.name: Rahode tribe
entities.description: A fierce tribe that worships Gahiji.

entities.name: Battle of Flat Sky
entities.description: Battle in which Gahiji saved the Rahode tribe from slaughter.

entities.name: Battle of Split Peak
entities.description: Battle in which Derevi routed the Grixis hordes.

entities.name: Herald's Army
entities.description: Infamous army Roon joined before deserting.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Hordes defeated by Derevi at Split Peak.

events.summary: Nekusar is killed in his own throne room after a plot to assassinate a rival backfires, but returns as a lich lord.
events.quote: When one of his plots to assassinate a rival backfired, Nekusar was killed in his own throne room.

events.summary: Gahiji charges into the foes of the Rahode at the Battle of Flat Sky and saves the tribe.
events.quote: He saved the tribe, and now Gahiji dwells with them in a place of honor.

events.summary: Derevi's strategy routs the Grixis hordes at the Battle of Split Peak.
events.quote: Her brilliant strategy routed the Grixis hordes at the Battle of Split Peak.

events.summary: Roon slaughters innocents by mistake, deserts the Herald's Army and receives a vision of the Hidden Realm.
events.quote: But after a mistaken slaughter of innocents, he deserted and wandered in the wilderness.

relations.note: The Church has put a price on her head.
relations.quote: The powerful Church of Avacyn has put a price on her head

relations.note: Worshipped by them and saved them.
